messages:
sara_cs: FYI customer ACME (acct acme-corp) reporting intermittent 503s from hosted inference in eu-west2. Spike started ~10:12 UTC, repeats every ~5–10m. They see ~12% 5xx on steady traffic. attaching sample curl and logs below.

matt_net: thanks — seeing correlated packet loss and multipath reroutes on our eu-west2-az3 egress to TransitProviderX. Graphs: RTT spikes + dropped packets on ASN 64512 peer.

olga_oncall: tagging net team @matt_net and SRE. Any link to a maintenance window?

matt_net: no announced maintenance. BGP updates show frequent NEXT_HOP changes for a subset of prefixes starting 10:11:55 UTC. Looks like ECMP instability / partial withdraws.

kevin_sre: reproducer from support: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/v1/generate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" \ 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-lite-2","input":"ping"}' 
```
Response intermittently returns: 
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream gateway timeout"}
```
Logs show upstream connection reset by peer (RST) from edge->transit.

sara_cs: customer provided timestamps and request IDs. They said it started after they switched to eu-west2 region earlier today. Customer impact: API retries and timeouts, pages ops. They want ETA.

deploy-bot: Canary in eu-west2-az3 reported 5xx spike at 2024-09-20T10:12:16Z, rollback not triggered (route-level fallback disabled).

matt_net: immediate mitigation options: 1) enable cross-az fallback for hosted routing (route traffic to eu-west2-az1/az2) 2) add temporary BGP prepend to prefer alternate transit 3) request provider support. Suggest 1 + 3 now.

olga_oncall: can we flip fallback for this customer only (pin to alt AZ) or need org-wide?

kevin_sre: we can apply per-tenant routing override in the control plane — will add a canary rule to prefer eu-west2-az2 for acme-corp. Doing it now.

matt_net: opened ticket with TransitProviderX (ref TX-9984) including pcap, BGP AS_PATH snapshots, and traceroutes. Provider acknowledged potential NP problem on handed off fiber.

acme_ops: our side: we started seeing 5xx at 10:11, had to enable client-side retries with exponential backoff. Impacted user-facing inference jobs, queued some requests. Thanks for fast triage.

kevin_sre: routing override applied at 10:20 UTC for acme-corp -> traffic shifted to az2. Initial metrics: 90% reduction in 5xx for that tenant. Waiting on provider fix.

olga_oncall: follow-ups: 1) keep ticket open with provider, escalate if no stabilization in 30m; 2) evaluate turning on route-level cross-tenant fallback for eu-west2 for 1h; 3) postmortem once resolved. Assigning owners: matt_net (provider engagement), kevin_sre (routing override + rollback criteria), sara_cs (customer comms). :thumbsup:

sara_cs: I'll update ACME with the mitigation and ETA: "mitigation applied, traffic shifted, monitoring for 30m, provider engaged." Will request customer logs if we need deeper repro.

matt_net: note for postmortem: capture BGP update frequency, provider interface optics, and our egress queue stats. Also check if KV cache or batching changes coincided with customer onboarding earlier today.

kevin_sre: logging note: add request_id -> egress session mapping to ease future triage (ticketed).

deploy-bot: incident alarm cleared for acme-corp after routing override at 10:22 UTC (monitored window ongoing).

olga_oncall: closing loop when provider confirms fix and when customer is happy. If anything else spikes, re-open channel.
